items.title: BE — Computer Science & Engineering
items.description: Built a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and system design. Developed an early interest in full-stack development through academic projects and self-driven learning. This phase shaped my approach to writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

items.title: Higher Secondary Education — MPC
items.description: Completed intermediate education with a strong focus on mathematics and analytical subjects. Built disciplined study habits and logical thinking skills essential for engineering.This period laid the academic groundwork for pursuing computer science.

items.title: Freelance Web Developer
items.description: Worked as an independent web developer delivering custom websites and applications for personal clients. Collaborated with clients from Hyderabad and Bangalore, translating business requirements into functional web solutions. Handled end-to-end development including UI, backend integration, deployment, and maintenance.

items.title: Transition to Professional Full-Stack Development
items.description: Moved from internship-level contributions to owning production-ready features. Applied hands-on learning to scalable systems and real client requirements. Began working closely with designers, backend teams, and stakeholders.
